f50.name: Falcon 50
f50.note: Base type — full content set. CAE Operating Handbook, FlightSafety PTM Vol 2 sourced.

f50ex.name: Falcon 50EX
f50ex.apu: GTCP36-150F — standard (ground use unless AFM says otherwise)
f50ex.note: Same type rating as Falcon 50 (DA-50). Same airframe. Three key deltas: DEEC start logic, Pro Line 4 cockpit, APU standard. Many airframes retrofitted with Universal InSight or APBI winglets.

f900.name: Falcon 900 / 900B / 900C / 900EX
f900.note: Larger airframe than 50. Two hydraulic systems with #3 engine as cross-coverage backup (different from 50's three-system arch). Same DA-50 type rating as long as NOT an EASy variant. Special-emphasis: forward-CG heavy takeoff (N823RC lesson) and PITCH FEEL caution response (Olympic 3838 lesson).

f900easy.name: Falcon 900EX EASy / DX / LX
f900easy.avionics: Dassault EASy I / EASy II (Honeywell Primus Epic)
f900easy.note: SEPARATE TYPE RATING — DA-EASY, NOT DA-50. EASy cockpit = 4 large LCDs, cursor control, integrated FMS + autothrottle + SmartView SVS + RAAS. 900LX adds winglets. Falcon 900DX is the budget version with redesigned (reduced) fuel system.
